hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-none text-white
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-sans font-medium tracking-tight text-white

visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely subtle. Drop shadows should only be used to separate overlapping elements, e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]. Avoid glowing shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Precision is critical. Use 1px solid border-neutral-800 or border-white/10 for cards. Avoid thick borders.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Muted, restrained. Use radial gradients for subtle spotlight effects behind key components (e.g., behind the hero dashboard), not as full backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used sparingly. Mostly for the sticky navigation (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/70) to keep the page professional. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where text readability might suffer.

grids.bento: Asymmetrical grids for feature cards. Strict, dense grids for dashboard mockups mimicking a control center.
grids.dashboard_mockup: High density grid, gap-4, precise alignments. No wasted space, mimicking Palantir/Linear.

layouts.hero: Center-aligned text overlaying a subtle NYC skyline with heavy overlay, leading into a dense, realistic dashboard mockup.
layouts.sections: Wide, generous padding between sections (py-24 to py-32).
layouts.dashboard_previews: Tight technical layout. Mimic real interfaces with sidebars, headers, and precise data tables.

motion.reveal: Subtle fade up (opacity 0 to 1, y 20 to 0) on scroll using framer-motion.
motion.hover: Minimalist. Borders lighten slightly (border-neutral-600), background shifts slightly, text color brightens. No bouncy scaling.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Muted gold on dark background needs careful contrast check.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings should be 2px solid muted gold, offset by 2px (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C7A36B] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A]).

hero_bg.description: Empire State building at night for hero background. Must have a heavy black gradient overlay (e.g., from-black via-black/80 to-black/40) so text is 100% readable.

owner_reporting.description: Monochromatic view of city from a high rise, to accompany the owner reporting section.

data_abstraction.description: Abstract gold data dots to be used subtly in the fragmented-sources-to-central-platform visual section.

component_instructions.Navigation: Sticky nav, backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0A0A]/80. Logo 'Obelix' in serif font. Links in small sans text. Include 'Book a Demo' CTA in muted gold.
component_instructions.Dashboard_Cards: Use div components acting as cards with extreme restraint. bg-[#141414], border border-[#2A2A2A], rounded-sm. Padding should be precise.
component_instructions.Today_Priorities_Table: Dense, realistic HTML table or Shadcn Table. Status badges with muted green/red text and 10% opacity backgrounds. Include working interactive filters.
component_instructions.Violation_Workflow: 7-step horizontal timeline on desktop, vertical on mobile. Use muted gold for active step, neutral-600 for inactive. Connected by thin 1px lines. Include a violation detail panel.
component_instructions.Mobile_Interface: Mockup of a phone showing a work-order/property manager interface. Use tight spacing and smaller fonts.
component_instructions.Comparison_Table: Clean grid, showing Obelix vs 'Fragmented Tools'. Use muted gold checks.
component_instructions.Early_Access_Form: Shadcn input/form components. Minimalist styling: sharp corners, thin borders, focus states in gold. Form must be frontend-only with instant confirmation state.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium SaaS landing page for institutional real estate. Think BlackRock meets Linear. It must NOT look like a generic template.
The hero must feature a REALISTIC dashboard mockup built with HTML/Tailwind. It needs to look like a functional app (12 Buildings / 192 Units / 96.4% Rent Collected).
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for the main impressive headlines and 'Inter' for all the dashboard UI and body text. Load these fonts from Google Fonts.
Do NOT use heavy gradients or bright neon colors. Stick strictly to the charcoal, slate, and muted gold palette.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements to facilitate testing.
Ensure all dashboard mockups have realistic NYC real estate data (e.g., '192 Units', 'HPD Violation #40291', 'DOB Compliance'). No lorem ipsum.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons with a thin stroke (1.5) to keep the premium technical feel.
Implement the interactive tabs/filters for the Today's Priorities table and the approval buttons in the owner reporting mockup.
Build a custom visual for 'fragmented-sources-to-central-platform' showing data flowing into Obelix.
The final CTA is a working frontend-only form. When submitted, it should swap to a clean confirmation message.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, using borders and surface colors, not heavy shadows.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200). Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing between major sections (e.g., py-24 or py-32).
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and precise selection states separate good from extraordinary.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖, 💡, 🚀) as icons.
